As a backend engineer with six years of experience building scalable, event-driven systems, I have successfully owned and optimized high-throughput routing services in TypeScript on Node.js and PostgreSQL. At Northwind Robotics, I led the order-routing service handling approximately 2 million events per day, where I implemented schema design, query tuning, and logical replication to ensure reliability and performance under load. My work directly contributed to reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340ms through a zero-downtime Strangler-fig migration of a monolith to event-driven services over nine months.

In my role as engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, I managed a team of five engineers across dispatch and billing product lines, aligning technical execution with business outcomes. I leveraged Kubernetes and Terraform to streamline service deployment, ensuring consistent, reliable infrastructure for production systems. This experience strengthened my ability to lead technical initiatives while maintaining a strong focus on system resilience and developer velocity.

I am drawn to Kestrel Mobility’s focus on event-driven routing services in TypeScript on Postgres, as it aligns directly with my proven expertise in building and scaling high-performance backend systems. My hands-on experience with PostgreSQL optimization, event-driven architecture, and production-grade TypeScript applications positions me to contribute immediately to your engineering goals.
